note: Routes were traced from real Mapillary photo tracks (survey 2026-11-06). Edit waypoints here if needed, then run capture.bat. Sequence filters keep route 1 on the flyover and drop northbound drives from route 2.

groups.title: Route 1: Entry to Flyover
groups.summary: Entering Gurugram from Delhi on NH-48 (southbound), staying on the main carriageway and going straight up and over the Shankar Chowk flyover. Ends just after the flyover; nothing beyond it is included.
groups.look_for: Wide 8-lane expressway, concrete crash barriers and yellow-black dividers, high-tension power lines and pylons, overhead gantry signs, glass office blocks on both sides, the flyover deck and its parapets.

groups.title: Route 2: Entry towards Building No. 5
groups.summary: Same entry on NH-48, but keeping left before the flyover onto the ground-level road at Shankar Chowk. The road curves left into DLF Cyber City and continues to DLF Building No. 5, where a set of photos shows the building from every direction available.
groups.look_for: Underside of the flyover and its pillars, the slip road and Shankar Chowk junction, e-rickshaws and autos, Cyber Hub signage, Cyber City glass towers, kerbs and medians, then the Building 5 frontage and surroundings.
